I can’t say enough amazing things about Eva. My dog Myra had a traumatic grooming experience over two years ago that resulted in part of her tail being cut off by another groomer. Since then, I’ve been too scared to let anyone touch her, and I’ve been trying to groom her myself. After recently breaking my hand, I realized I needed help, and after a lot of research, I found Eva and her wonderful reviews. The crazy part is she’s right around the corner.

Eva spent so much time letting Myra get to know her and feel comfortable in her shop. I know this wasn’t an easy groom, Myra is still traumatized, and honestly, so am I.  Eva made the entire experience positive and gentle. Even at 15 years old, Myra came out looking and acting like a puppy again.

I highly recommend Eva. I wish every groomer cared about animals the way she does. She gave Myra not just a groom, but trust and comfort  and that means everything.

I recently purchased a beautiful micro bully from Legacy Pet Care Houston All Star Groomers, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience! The price was great—very fair for the quality and care that clearly went into raising the pup.

What stood out to me the most is that this is a family-owned business, and you can really feel the difference. They treat their animals and customers with genuine care and attention. The dog I brought home was already well-trained, socialized, and clearly raised in a loving environment.

The team was friendly, knowledgeable, and made the whole process smooth and stress-free. If you’re looking for a high-quality bully or grooming services in the Houston area, I highly recommend giving them a visit.

Big thanks to everyone at Legacy Pet Care—you’ve earned a lifelong customer!

I wanted to try out this place, so I went by to see it & talk to the groomer before taking my fur baby. I was pleased with the cleanliness & after talking to the owner, I decided to give them a try. I told her to just cut him all the way off so we could just start over however she refused because she said she just need time to work on him. I was expecting to come back to find him all shaved but she worked her magic & I am pleased.

Eva was so accommodating on getting my sweet girl groomed. Her son and her did an amazing job, they made me feel 100% comfortable with leaving my baby there. Would definitely recommend, so happy I found my new go to groomer!
